The '''quoler''' was an aquatic [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Osirrag]]. Quolers were the primary aquatic prey of the [[onahk]].

==Behavior==
Quolers lived in underwater warrens dug below the surface of [[Osirrag]]'s temperate, shallow marshes and wetlands. They were preyed upon by the native [[onahk]]s, amphibians which spent the summer season patrolling the wetlands, and the winter hunting [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. These agile creatures were adept enough to wriggle around underwater obstacles such as roots, in order to dig into quoler warrens. Onahks were fearful of any creatures larger than their typical quoler prey, such as [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="CotG" />
